jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: The AWS Networking organization is hiring, and we’re looking for talented Software Development Engineers (SDE) to join our team. Within Networking, we’re confronting and solving complex and high-stake challenges. Our teams support the design of connectivity between the hundreds of AWS location and thousands of services. As a member of the Backbone Engineering team, you will play a part in designing and architecting software feeding Network Engineers with critical information about AWS Backbone network performance. This position is part of the Backbone organization where the team is responsible for building solutions that increase the scale, efficiency and resiliency of the AWS Backbone. Ever wonder how Amazon manages the capacity of thousands of network links? How Amazon offers a highly available and scalable network? Engineers on this team collaborate with various teams to automate capacity allocation of AWS services workloads into the network. Engineers on this team make day-to-day and strategic decisions that carry a huge amount of responsibility and impact. We strive to have a collaborative environment that impacts products and software across the company. We use AWS technologies like: DynamoDB, SWF, S3, EC2, API Gateway, Lambda, ELB, RDS, and Athena We are one of the many teams ensuring Amazon's network maintains 100% uptime We are spread across Seattle, Dublin and Sydney Our work has a direct impact on internal and external customers We own and operate the infrastructure required to serve our customers Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce; we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you would like to request an accommodation for the interview or onboarding process, please let us know and we will connect you to our accommodation team. You may also reach them directly by visiting https://www.amazon.jobs/en/disability/us Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Mentorship and Career growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Key job responsibilities Engineers build software and deploy products that enable the backbone to be utilized as an efficient service by our customers. Our customers utilize our services to visualize the performance of AWS Backbone network that crosses the entire plant, identify where in the real-world availability risk and congestion occur to plan and act to protect the network. • Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security. • Write high quality distributed system software • Enjoy seeing the impact of your work has on customers. • Work in an agile, startup-like development environment, where you are always working on the most important stuff. • Take ownership and do what it takes to get the job done. • Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best. About the team We are a group of engineers that value diverse perspectives, collaborate freely, and believe we should help each other succeed (and fail) as a team. We love to learn and take ownership for our work, and we think you probably do too. As a member of our team, you will have opportunities to stretch your skills, whether that means resolving deep algorithmic knots in our backend services or designing a better user experience for our technical users. The various technical and functional partnership gives us the opportunity to extend our knowledges, individual skills and collective ownership. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, MN, Minneapolis - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually USA, WA, Seattle - 143,700.00 - 194,400.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Cloud Network Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Microsoft Digital (MSD) delivers the technology, platforms, and services that support Microsoft employees and operations worldwide. By combining engineering, business, and operational expertise, MSD develops and manages solutions that help drive efficiency, security, and reliability across the enterprise. As a Cloud Network Software Engineer , you will develop software, automation, and AI-enabled solutions that support Microsoft's High Value Assets (HVA) and Treasury network infrastructure. You will work on cloud-native applications, developer tools, automation frameworks, and operational services that enable network engineering teams to manage and operate enterprise-scale environments. In this role, you will partner with software engineers, network engineers, security teams, and platform stakeholders to develop tools and services that support network provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management. You will also contribute to operational readiness by participating in on-call support and continuously improving the reliability and maintainability of network services. This position requires software engineering experience, familiarity with modern development practices, and working knowledge of datacenter networking technologies. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and maintain software platforms and services that support Microsoft's High Value Assets (HVA) network environments. Build and enhance cloud-native applications, APIs, developer tools, and automation solutions that support network provisioning, operations, and lifecycle management. Develop AI-enabled solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent agents, and machine learning technologies to assist with network diagnostics, configuration management, incident response, and operational workflows. Create reusable software components and internal platforms that improve engineering efficiency, consistency, and maintainability. Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and deployment processes for network infrastructure and services. Develop telemetry, monitoring, analytics, and visualization capabilities that provide insights into network performance, reliability, and operational health. Build self-service tools and engineering platforms that support network engineering teams and streamline service delivery processes. Collaborate with software engineers, network engineers, security professionals, and cloud infrastructure teams to deliver reliable and scalable technical solutions. Apply software engineering best practices related to code quality, testing, documentation, security, and operational excellence. Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and cloud technologies to identify opportunities for improving network operations and engineering processes. Maintain technical documentation, network inventory records, and infrastructure lifecycle information to support operational and compliance requirements. Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to support security, regulatory, and Zero Trust requirements and ensure alignment with organizational standards and policies. Participate in a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and on-call rotation to support the availability, reliability, performance, and observability of HRE and Treasury services. Investigate and resolve service incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to improve operational readiness and service resilience. Work closely with architects, engineers, service owners, product teams, and security partners to deliver solutions and continuously improve enterprise network capabilities. Embody our culture and values . Qualifications Required Qualifications: Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 1+ year(s) technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 2+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR equivalent experience. Preferred Qualifications: Doctorate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field OR Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years technical experience in network design, development, and automation OR equivalent experience. Experience building software tools, automation platforms, or operational solutions. Exposure to AI/ML technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), GitHub Copilot, or AI-enabled engineering workflows is preferred. Demonstrated ability to analyze technical issues, troubleshoot complex systems, and develop scalable software solutions.Relevant networking certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP) are a plus. Experience with software development practices such as source control, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code (IaC), API development, and automated testing.Working knowledge of datacenter networking technologies, including TCP/IP, routing and switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, network security, and troubleshooting methodologies. #MSD #MSDJOBS #CNE #CloudNetworkEngineer #Cisco #Arista #PaloAlto #F5 Cloud Network Engineering IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Leo Optical Inter-Satellite Link
jobs.description: Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon LEO will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth’s most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join this ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in distributed systems and software design. Come work at Amazon! Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities Design, develop, and optimize highly reliable flight software for optical inter-satellite link systems, spanning low-level device drivers and real-time control loops to high-level autonomous behaviors, fault management, and AI/ML-driven decision-making that target embedded linux and RTOS (Real Time Operating System) Architect and implement fault-tolerant, redundant software systems that keep optical links alive across a constellation of satellites, including health monitoring and autonomous recovery without ground intervention Build and maintain robust test, validation, and simulation infrastructure, from hardware-in-the-loop testbeds and software-in-the-loop virtualizations to automated regression suites Own the full lifecycle of embedded software delivery - from requirements decomposition and architecture design through implementation, code review, integration, deployment, and long-term maintenance of software running on satellites in orbit Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams spanning hardware, optics, systems, communications, and operations engineers to design, integrate, test, and deploy high-speed optical communication systems that push the boundaries of space-based networking Drive continuous improvement of deployment and over-the-air (OTA) update processes, ensuring new capabilities and fixes can be safely and reliably delivered to hundreds of satellites on orbit with minimal operational risk Partner with software and hardware teams to lead board bring-up and integration efforts, including developing and debugging low-level BSP (Board Support Package) components, validating peripheral connectivity (Ethernet, PCIe, SPI, I2C, flash devices), and ensuring seamless hardware-software integration from prototype through production A day in the life A day in the life As a Software Engineer on the Optical Inter-Satellite Link team, you won't just write code - you'll see it fly. Your software will control and monitor high-speed laser communications between satellites moving at orbital velocities, and you'll be there for every stage of the journey: from early design and on-the-ground verifications to watching your code commission an optical link for the first time in orbit. About the team You will join a multi-disciplinary team of top-notch engineers whose work spans an unusually wide aperture: embedded flight software running on satellites in orbit, cloud-based systems powering mission and network operations, automation frameworks that keep a growing constellation healthy, and AI-driven capabilities that make our optical links smarter with every orbit. We collaborate closely with optical, electrical, firmware, opto-mechanical, and operations teams — and with partner organizations including Mission Operations and Optical Network Operations — to deliver one of the most advanced optical communication systems ever built. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - Experience in embedded development in C/C++ - Experience writing low level drivers - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience with Linux system virtualization (QEMU/KVM) - Experience developing embedded software for space systems, including familiarity with optical communication systems, laser terminals, or high-speed serial interfaces - Experience with ARM-based SoCs - Experience with FPGA-adjacent software development, including register-level interfaces, DMA engines, or hardware/software co-design Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation.
